displayPattern: Outdoor control display reads L8 (ASXC/DSXC/GSXC AC and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pump outdoor units with the integrated control module)
meaning: Low line voltage: the supply voltage to the outdoor unit is below the specified range.
causes: Unit not wired as specified on the rating plate
diySteps: Check that the circuit breaker has not tripped (outdoor disconnect and main panel); the manual says to check circuit breakers and fuses and verify the unit is connected as specified on the rating plate
Technician: correct the low line voltage condition and contact the local utility if needed; if voltage is within specification, replace the board
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician; contact your utility if the supply voltage is low.
sourceTitle: Service and Troubleshooting: ASXC/DSXC/GSXC condensing units and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pumps (RS6200007 r27, hosted by Daikin Comfort)
